scripts.evidence.py:
"""Gather the matched runs' numbers into one evidence file."""
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path("OUT")
TOOL = Path("REPO/tools/log_process_load.py")
PY = "REPO/.venv/bin/python"


def load(name):
    text = subprocess.run([PY, str(TOOL), "summarize", str(OUT / f"{name}-load.jsonl")], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    summary = json.loads(text)
    summary.pop("windows", None)
    return summary


def run(name):
    manifest = json.loads((OUT / name / "manifest.json").read_text())
    state = json.loads((OUT / f"{name}-control" / "state.json").read_text())
    counters, timings = manifest["counters"], manifest["timings_seconds_this_invocation"]
    evaluator = manifest["runner"]["updates"][0]["evaluator"]
    playing = timings["collection"]
    summary = load(name)
    games = summary["processes"]["game processes"]
    server = summary["processes"]["coordinator"]
    return {
        "run": name, "code": "before" if name.startswith("old") else "after", "status": manifest["status"],
        "games": counters["episodes"], "decisions": counters["decisions"], "chance_events": counters["chance_events"],
        "playing_seconds": round(playing, 1), "decisions_per_hour_while_playing": round(counters["decisions"] / playing * 3600),
        "games_per_hour_while_playing": round(counters["episodes"] / playing * 3600, 1),
        "network_evaluations": evaluator["evaluations"], "network_evaluations_per_second": round(evaluator["evaluations"] / playing, 1),
        "inference_batches": evaluator["serving_rounds"],
        "mean_inference_batch_states": round(evaluator["evaluations"] / evaluator["serving_rounds"], 2),
        "inference_server_waiting_share": round(evaluator["idle_seconds"] / playing, 4),
        "inference_server_answering_share": round(evaluator["forward_seconds"] / playing, 4),
        "inference_server_answering_us_per_evaluation": round(evaluator["forward_seconds"] / evaluator["evaluations"] * 1e6, 1),
        "peak_rss_bytes_sampled": state["aggregate_sampled_peak_rss_bytes"],
        "batch_cpu_cores": summary["batch_cores"], "other_work_cpu_cores": summary["other_work_cores"],
        "game_processes_cpu_seconds": games["cpu_seconds"],
        "game_processes_cpu_ms_per_network_evaluation": round(games["cpu_seconds"] / evaluator["evaluations"] * 1e3, 3),
        "game_processes_cpu_ms_per_decision": round(games["cpu_seconds"] / counters["decisions"] * 1e3, 1),
        "game_processes_instructions_per_network_evaluation": round(games["instructions"] / evaluator["evaluations"]),
        "game_processes_performance_core_share": games["performance_core_share"],
        "game_processes_waiting_for_a_core_per_cpu_second": games["waiting_per_cpu_second"],
        "inference_server_cpu_seconds": server["cpu_seconds"],
        "load_summary": summary,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    runs = [run(name) for name in sys.argv[1:]]
    print(json.dumps(runs, indent=1))
